a.text: Being upfront: with a 75% storm chance after every round, the plan of building the reserve to 8 first gives us about a 6% chance of surviving. So I intend to take 4 in round 1 rather than follow the agreement. I'm telling you now so you can plan around it, not discover it afterward. If I end up with 4, I'll operate every remaining round so the generator can refill the reserve for you.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round. That broke our agreement, and I'm not pretending otherwise. From now on I'll operate every round so the reserve can climb back to 4 for you. Please operate too, since the generator only runs if we both do.
